banking-economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has announced final leverage ratio requirements for commercial banks, to be implemented starting April 1, 2027. Domestic systemically important banks must maintain a minimum leverage ratio of 4%, while other commercial banks need a ratio of 3.5%. Branches of global systemically important banks will also have specific requirements. Feedback from banks was reviewed and modifications were made before finalizing the rules.

banking-economy.title: Real-time payments explained: How money moves between bank accounts in seconds
banking-economy.summary: Real-time payments allow money to move between bank accounts within seconds, making transactions faster and more convenient for consumers and businesses. In India, systems such as UPI and IMPS enable instant transfers, while RTGS processes high-value payments in real time. Here is how these systems work, the technology that powers them, their benefits for businesses and customers, and the security challenges.

banking-economy.title: NHB appoints forensic auditor for SRG Housing Finance
banking-economy.summary: The National Housing Bank (NHB) has appointed ASA & Associates LLP to conduct a forensic audit of SRG Housing Finance amid allegations of fictitious loan accounts worth ₹300–400 crore, repayment record manipulation and possible fund diversion.
